Hands, sandal contact, sari folds and doorway geometry are credible at viewed original size. No religious or biographical identification is implied.

assets.method: Individual full image inspection via view_image
findings: Standing man gestures to his own chest while two seated listeners look doubtful; the contrast supports attention versus esteem as an explicitly imagined analogy.

findings: Empty sleeve and a small remainder of cups contrast with the arriving full packet. Both grips plausibly support their lightweight objects; kettle, tray and paper cups are legible.

assets.method: Individual full image inspection via view_image
findings: Raised open palm clearly pauses the offered folders. Stack is supported beneath; seated arm/desk contacts and standing anatomy are plausible.
Original office analogy conveys a limit on repeated requests without presenting a farming demonstration or blaming generosity. Blank folders and ordinary clothes introduce no documentary identity.

assets.approved_alt: A seated worker raises an open hand as a coworker offers an additional stack of folders.
assets.source_limits: Editorial concession/pressure application, not attested original use; do not depict farming technique or blame generosity.

assets.method: Individual full image inspection via view_image
findings: Open earthen vessel has a coherent elliptical rim and visible unfilled interior; arching blade and suspended drop make the small-input/large-need contrast immediately legible.
Drops are deliberately enlarged for a stylized close-up. Acceptable poetic scale metaphor, not measured botanical or dew-harvesting physics. No hands, apparatus or scientific impossibility claim.

assets.approved_alt: A dew-covered grass blade hangs above the open mouth of a mostly empty earthen pot.
assets.source_limits: Literal scale metaphor, not a scientific assertion about impossibility of harvesting dew, plant taxonomy or source incident.

overall_findings: All five originals individually viewed. Monochrome ink contours, white space and light-to-moderate hatching are consistent; denser doorway/furniture texture remains subordinate to figures. No text artifacts or blocking anatomy/geometry errors observed.
